component.name: CloudDrop
component.summary: Keep a folder uploaded to Google Drive

description.p: CloudDrop uploads everything you put in a folder to Google Drive, keeping the same folder structure. It only ever uploads: deleting a file on your computer never deletes it from Drive, so you can free up disk space and still download any file back later.

ul.li: New and edited files are uploaded automatically, edits become new versions
Renames and moves are applied in Drive without uploading again
Large uploads resume after a network drop, a reboot or a crash
Free up space only after checking that the Drive copy is identical
A top-bar icon shows progress and lets you pause uploads

description.p: CloudDrop talks to Google Drive with your own OAuth client, so your files never pass through a third-party server.
